column1: List of reported tornadoes - Friday, May 8, 2009
column4: Intermittent tornado path with damage to trees and outbuildings.
column5: 50 structures were damaged with two buildings uninhabitable.
column6: A few outbuildings were destroyed and one house sustained heavy damage.
column7: Several outbuildings and barns were damaged or destroyed with heavy damage to some frame homes.
column8: Several outbuildings were damaged, along with many trees.
column9: Three houses was heavily damaged, along with many outbuildings by a large wedge tornado. Severe damage to trees.
column10: A dairy farm lost its roof, a truck was lofted over a fence and an outbuilding was destroyed.
column11: One home lost its roof and several trees were snapped with treetops carried over 1/4 mile.
column12: Two homes and several outbuildings were damaged with numerous trees snapped and debarked by a large wedge tornado.
column13: 1 death - Three frame homes and numerous outbuildings were destroyed. One other person were injured.
column14: A barn was destroyed and minor home damage was reported.
column15: Seven outbuildings were destroyed with three homes damaged as well as intense tree damage.
column16: Several outbuildings were destroyed and numerous trees were uprooted.
column17: Several outbuildings were damaged and numerous trees were uprooted.
column18: Four homes and several outbuildings were damaged, and a mobile home was destroyed.
column19: One house, one mobile home, one travel trailer, two outbuildings and an auto shop were destroyed. Cars were tossed 40 to 50 yards away and two school buses were blown over.
column20: A few homes and numerous trees were damaged.
column21: A farm house was lifted and moved injuring two people. Two auto shops and several homes and outbuildings were damaged or destroyed. Many trees were snapped or uprooted with $13 million in tree damage.
column22: One barn was destroyed and one mobile home lost its roof.
column23: 2 homes had roof damage with significant tree damage.
column24: Damage limited to trees. Tornado caught on tape.
column25: Brief tornado damaged a few trees.
column26: Brief tornado damaged a few trees.
column28: Structural damage to two barns, shingle damage to homes, power poles blown over and dozens of trees snapped or uprooted.
column29: Brief tornado remained in open fields.
column30: An office trailer at a coal company was blown off its foundation.
column31: Brief tornado touchdown that was photographed with no damage.
column32: Damage to many trees in rural areas.
column33: Brief tornado separate from the main derecho with no damage.
column35: Brief tornado remained in a plowed field.
column37: Three outbuildings were destroyed and one home and a pole barn were damaged.
column38: 2 deaths - Severe damage along the path with over 150 houses damaged, some of which were destroyed. The two fatalities took place in a mobile home which was thrown into a nearby pond. The Bluegrass Army Depot was also damaged. 15 others were injured, some seriously.
column39: Two structures had metal roofing torn off. Several trees were knocked down including one that damaged the porch of a home.
column41: Brief tornado with damage to several trees.
column42: One mobile home was destroyed and several other buildings were damaged, some of which were by falling trees.
column43: Seven homes were damaged and a free standing cellphone tower collapsed and was twisted by the tornado.
column44: Two large barns were destroyed and one home lost its roof.
column45: Heavy damage to barns and outbuildings with roof damage to homes and numerous downed trees.
column46: Tornado touchdown reported/confirmed by law enforcement. No damage reported.
column48: Trees were uprooted, one of them fell on a mobile home. Minor roof damage to two homes.
column49: Two trailers and several outbuildings were destroyed. A third trailer was damaged.
column51: One barn was destroyed, one home had moderate damage and 100 trees were snapped or uprooted.
column53: A mobile home was destroyed where four people were injured. Five houses and several outbuildings were damaged and cement silos were toppled. There were two additional injuries.
column54: Three outbuildings were destroyed and one home and a pole barn were damaged.
